A remote sensing ocean color detection across equator in some specific ocean area.
Description

A remote sensing ocean color detection across equator in some specific ocean area. Data downlink through 8200 or 8250MHz transmission, and using UHF for spacecraft tele-command/ telemetry processing. 

Two 3U satellites, equipped with an RGB imager and a software-defined radio (SDR), are set to perform in-orbit demonstrations for our undisclosed customers.
